findings.message: The report gives two different deadlines for the remaining triage field/class map. Lines 127 and 137 say it must be closed 'before T2'. Step 4 (line 214) says the internal T0 source/field map must be complete 'before T1', which matches the packet: it puts the triage field/class freeze in T0, and T0 comes before T1. This does not add any external approval requirement, and step 4 is the stricter, correct reading. Optionally change lines 127 and 137 to 'before T1 (T0 deliverable)' so the two places agree.

The receipt says that the formatting result and the final delta-review result 'are recorded after their actual runs', and that the final stable full-format run 'follows review2'. Both are honestly marked as pending. They are not yet recorded at ba2e0b79, so add them after this review instead of treating them as done.

scope:
Read-only Architect review of frozen commit ba2e0b79, limited to the corrected delta since 68ca62df. HEAD was confirmed as ba2e0b797615b7f06000afcf7b7564347bf9b8f0, and tracked R-0025 content has no diff against it. The only untracked files are this review's prompt and temp files. Nothing was modified. Primary and scorecard content was not read, and earlier source checks were not repeated, except for spot checks of the lines whose citations were corrected.

Receipt: reviews/P4-02-preflight/validation.md now exists. The inventory sentence at line 241, which cites the accompanying validation receipt, is therefore backed. The receipt lists the documentation checks that passed. It also states plainly that no runtime tests, T1 RED, generator runs or HTTP acceptance were run. SQL work is described as a READ ONLY/ROLLBACK fixture observation, not production qualification. This resolves the medium finding from review 1.

Prompt integrity: reports/P4-02-review-1-original-prompt.md hashes to c917c24f…de936, both in the working tree and at ba2e0b79. That equals the prompt_sha256 in review-1.bridge.json. The reviews/P4-02-preflight/review-1-prompt.md file hashes to 0dd2366f…, which is a different value, so it is a formatted copy. validation.md says this explicitly and does not present the copy as the hashed original. review-1.json hashes to ba9cf059…8de57, equal to the bridge output_sha256, so the review 1 output and receipt are unchanged. reports/ is excluded from prettier by .prettierignore:85, so the archived original bytes will not be rewritten.

Low and info findings from review 1, all resolved:
(1) Gate timing. Step 4 now places the shared-role predicates, the command-path clarification and the legacy disposition before T2. Identity, risk and deployed inventory are now release gates. Fixture-provisioned testing is explicitly allowed, and it says no production inputs are needed before T1. This matches packet lines 99–110.
(2) The audit.facade.ts citation is now 24–27, and the listRaitCaseEvent call at line 25 was checked.
(3) requirePoolBinding now names rait-worklist-command.service.ts, and line 1232 was checked.
(4) Impediment was added to the mapped surfaces, and batch was added to the list of surfaces with no surface rule.
(5) inf.infraction.risk_flag at 38-inf-infraction.sql:19 is listed as a default-only value, not an authoritative risk source. The default SEM_RISCO was checked.
(6) The triage consumer table lists the known fields. It describes the remaining projection and document-class map as unfinished internal T0 work, not as an external blocker.

No new approval requirement was invented. The report keeps its statement that these are prerequisites, not a request to repeat approval of P4-02 or D1–D7. Leaving out undefined data is framed as non-exposure, not a new product rule. No runtime or Inspector acceptance, T0 completion, full-JW01 PASS, round closure or DEVAI proof-chain change is claimed. This is a PASS of the preflight report correction only, not acceptance of the implementation.
